title: C X.509 support contract
description: Add the minimal C/Zephyr Kconfig/API contract for PKIX certificate validation using mbedTLS X.509 when enabled, with a disabled-build-safe interface and documented trust-anchor/leaf-validation inputs. Do not implement path validation in this slice.
close_reason: Added mbedTLS X.509 Kconfig gate and disabled-build-safe DER-chain validation API contract with trust-anchor and leaf-constraint requirements. Kimi reviews unavailable due insufficient credits; fallback correctness/security/edge reviews found no defects.
